details.question: What is the primary memory bottleneck FlashAttention addresses on GPUs?
details.answer: On modern GPUs (such as NVIDIA A100), compute throughput is significantly faster than memory bandwidth. [flash_attention.md, page 1]

details.question: What is the bandwidth and capacity of on-chip SRAM compared to HBM on an NVIDIA A100 GPU?
details.answer: On-chip SRAM: Extremely fast memory (~19 TB/s bandwidth), but small capacity (192 KB per Streaming Multiprocessor on A100, totaling around 20MB across the GPU). [flash_attention.md, page 1]

details.question: How does FlashAttention compute exact attention without storing the full N x N matrix in HBM?
details.answer: FlashAttention computes exact softmax without storing the full $N \times N$ matrix in HBM by using tiling. [flash_attention.md, page 1]

details.question: What speedup does FlashAttention achieve over standard PyTorch attention?
details.answer:
FlashAttention achieves:
- 2x to 4x wall-clock speedup over standard PyTorch attention for sequence lengths from 128 to 4096. [flash_attention.md, page 1]

details.question: Does FlashAttention sacrifice mathematical precision compared to standard attention?
details.answer: - Exact equivalence: FlashAttention produces exact attention weights with zero loss in mathematical precision compared to standard attention. [flash_attention.md, page 1]

details.question: What maximum context length can FlashAttention scale to on a single GPU without memory exhaustion?
details.answer: - Enables context lengths up to 64k tokens on single GPUs without memory exhaustion. [flash_attention.md, page 1]

details.question: What is the time and memory complexity of standard self-attention relative to sequence length?
details.answer: Transformers are slow and memory-intensive on long sequences, since the time and memory complexity of self-attention are quadratic in sequence length. [flash_attention.md, page 1]

details.question: How are Q, K, and V matrices manipulated in the FlashAttention tiling algorithm?
details.answer: It breaks the $Q$, $K$, and $V$ matrices into blocks that fit entirely inside fast SRAM. [flash_attention.md, page 1]
